name: Passion (kaṣāya)
description: Anger, pride, deceit and greed: among the rising states (2.6), a cause of bondage (8.1), the reason the soul takes in karma-particles (8.2), the ground of conduct-deluding karma (6.14, 8.9), and one of the divisions of the lasting inflow (6.5).

name: The four passions (krodha, māna, māyā, lobha) with their four varieties
description: Each of anger, pride, deceit and greed has four varieties, anantānubandhī, apratyākhyāna, pratyākhyāna and saṃjvalana (8.9).

name: The non-passions (akaṣāya/nokaṣāya): nine
description: Laughter, liking, disliking, grief, fear, disgust and the three sex-drives, named as the second group of conduct-deluding karma (8.9).

name: The five causes of bondage
description: Wrong view, non-abstinence, carelessness, passions and activity (8.1).
